title: P1: Provider snapshots require the planned optional field
detail: ProviderSnapshot requires ephemeral at packages/protocol/src/index.ts:684. providers/list at line 754 and auth/logout at line 780 share that schema. The new CLI reuses a listening server (packages/sigma/src/client.ts:111), so a response from an older server fails provider discovery before login or fails decoding after logout (packages/sigma/src/login.ts:77 and :160). The review reproduced both with a scratch server. The implementation brief requires the capability field to be optional. Accept snapshots without the field and continue emitting an explicit boolean from current servers.
